name: Fumo
source:
Fumo is a sarcastic, yet detached person. She is also spirit of the infertility. 

Always in the shadow of Aina, she has learned to simply sit at the background.  She doesn't show much emotion as she basically feels there's no need as no one really pays no attention to her anyway.
